indicator-name-required.rule: name property MUST be present and non-empty

indicator-pattern-type-enum.expected_error_substring: pattern type should come from the STIX pattern type open vocabulary

malware-types-enum.rule: malware_types values MUST come from malware-type-ov

ipv4-address-format.rule: value MUST be a valid IPv4 address or CIDR block
ipv4-address-format.expected_error_substring: IPv4 address must be a valid dotted-decimal format

bundle-not-empty.rule: Bundle MUST contain at least one object
bundle-not-empty.expected_error_substring: Bundle must contain at least one object

revoked-sdo-parses.rule: Revoked objects are valid STIX and MUST be parseable; only versioning a revoked object is prohibited (spec 3.3)

revoked-sdo-timestamps-preserved.rule: Parsing a revoked object MUST NOT alter id/created/modified (parsing is not versioning)
